verdict.rationale: EBANX documents real outbound webhooks: it sends a signed HTTP POST to a configured Notification URL when payment status changes, and retries failed deliveries. The evidence covers only payment status notifications, though, and does not show event-type subscription or how the URL is registered, so the story is only partly covered. Missing for 10: documented event catalog or per-event subscription selection, programmatic (API) webhook registration, webhook coverage for payouts/refunds/chargebacks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: EBANX sends an HTTP POST request to the configured Notification URL. The request includes basic payment and status information, along with headers containing a digital signature
If your system fails to process a notification (e.g., due to a server error), EBANX will retry sending it multiple times.
